# SideNav

Provide access to navigation links in your app on the left side of the page.
See [Side Navigation guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/side-navigation/design/)

We recommend to use a permanent `Side Navigation` on desktop.<br />

Max allowed levels is 3, we support until that and no indendation afterwards.<br />

<Canvas of={SidenavStories.Basic} />

```css
.h-480 {
  height: 480px;
}
.pl-1 {
  padding-left: 1rem;
}
```

## Examples

### Dark Mode

<Canvas of={SidenavStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Multilevel navigation

Try not to use more than 3 levels of navigation.

<Canvas of={SidenavStories.Multilevel} />

### Selected category

You can optionnaly highlight the selected category by applying the `ds-sidenav-category--selected` modifier.

<Canvas of={SidenavStories.CategorySelected} />
